rule.title: Colocation of Feature Components and Hooks
rule.statement: Components, hooks, api callers, and types specific to a single feature must be colocated under src/features/<feature>/ rather than scattered into global directories.
rule.rationale: Scattering feature code into global components/, hooks/, and types/ creates high coupling and makes features difficult to maintain, delete, or refactor.
rule.implementation_guidance: Structure code as src/features/chat/ containing ChatWindow.tsx, useChat.ts, chat.api.ts, and chat.types.ts.

forbidden.example: Placing 80 custom hooks in global src/hooks/ and 120 components in global src/components/.

source.chapter: Chapter 5: Codebase Organization and Best Practices
source.evidence_quote: Colocating components, hooks, and types by feature keeps dependencies localized and simplifies long-term maintenance.
